facts.text: Participants found intentionally spreading false information, making defamatory claims, or engaging in coordinated actions intended to damage the reputation of WFunded may have their account suspended or terminated; WFunded reserves the right to cancel any pending payouts, void any profits generated on the account, and pursue legal remedies.
